description: Every bank tool the gateway knows. A tool missing from this list is blocked (deny by default). Name, category, description, impact and sensitive parameters must match the demo bank's catalogue; tests/test_gateway_matches_bank.py checks this. Which tasks may use each tool is bank policy, in policies/opa/agentsentinel/data.json (US-02a).

tools.description: Read one customer's profile and mailing address
List one customer's accounts and balances
List one customer's most recent transactions, newest first
Refund a posted transaction to the customer's own account
Close an open dispute with a resolution note
Export every customer record in the bank
Reset a customer's sign-in credentials (administrators only)
Freeze an account so no money can move in or out (administrators only)
